title: Inngest pipeline: real steps for reconstruct → scenegraph → journey → package
summary: Replace the M0 stub steps with the real durable workflow: reconstruct (Luma), scene graph, journey generation, and package assembly, each idempotent and retry-safe with timeouts and classified errors.

acceptance_tests.test: scan.submitted drives reconstruct → scenegraph → journey → package to a stored environment package; each step is idempotent (same event id, no duplicate work) and retries on vendor failure.
Tests cover step ordering, idempotency, and error classification; npm run lint/typecheck/test green; package-lock committed.
No secret in the repo; every vendor call site has a timeout constant.

history.event: Builder (AUTH #027): reconstruct step made real. Added the ports (ReconstructionService / ObjectStorage / EnvironmentStore in src/services.ts) + in-memory fakes (src/fakes.ts); fetch-based Supabase adapters (service-role Storage upload + environments PATCH, src/adapters.supabase.ts) and a Modal web-endpoint reconstruction client (src/adapters.modal.ts) — NO new npm dependency, so the audit surface is unchanged; src/deps.ts selects real adapters vs fakes from the environment. reconstruct now runs the self-host backend, stores splat + collision mesh (+ thumbnail) in the private 'environments' bucket under the owner-prefixed path {user_id}/{environment_id}/..., and writes splat_object/mesh_object/thumbnail_object/splat_count/package_bytes + status on the environments row (AUTH #034 schema); delivery stays signed-URL-only via the environment-urls edge function. Error classification (src/errors.ts): retryable vs terminal; the Inngest wrapper maps a terminal error to NonRetriableError and drives the row to 'failed'; the off-site guard (a real user scan is never sent off-site, ADR-0005 / AUTH #030) is terminal, mirroring reconstruction/models.py. Every external call site is timeout-bounded (TIMEOUTS_MS + withTimeout/AbortSignal). Tests: 17 pass (src/pipeline.test.ts ordering/idempotency/retry-propagation/timeouts + src/services.test.ts persistence-order/classification/off-site-guard/withTimeout/Modal+Supabase adapters via a stubbed fetch); npm run lint + typecheck + test green; no secrets. AT-2 met (tests + lint/typecheck/test green, package-lock unchanged). AT-3 met (no secret in repo; every vendor call site has a timeout). AT-1 PARTLY: the durable workflow + persistence are real and unit-proven, but a live scan.submitted -> stored-environment run needs the Modal web endpoint exposed and environment-urls deployed to staging (Operator, M1-CAPT-02). scenegraph + journey stay honest stubs (blocked by M1-DATA-01 schema freeze + the M1-SCEN tickets). Status open -> in-progress.

Operator (2026-09-28): the reconstruct backend now also runs corpus video end to end on Modal (modal_app.py --corpus: video -> frames -> SfM -> splat + collision mesh, outputs in gj-corpus:/open-video-recon/<slug>/). 15 open-video clips reconstructed (14 usable, 1 fail), ~$0.32/clip; see qa/reports/M1-CAPT-03-open-video-recon.md. Status unchanged.
